profile_text.body:
NNAISENSE, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Lugano, Switzerland, describes itself as building a next-generation quantitative multi-strategy hedge fund powered by generative AI. The company blends generative AI with institutional portfolio management to deliver diversified, low-correlation investment strategies across global equity, futures, and derivatives.

The company's core technology includes proprietary custom models called Bayesian Flow Networks and a Large Investing Model, which it describes as going beyond simple per-asset prediction by simulating entire future market scenarios. NNAISENSE operates a Risk Control Room for continuous monitoring of data quality, model accuracy, and portfolio exposures. According to its website, the company has partnered with ACATIS Investment KVG mbH and other financial institutions since its founding, combining AI-driven stock selection with portfolio construction technology.

In 2025, ACATIS acquired NNAISENSE, which the company states further strengthens its ability to pair advanced AI with established value investing principles while advancing its multi-strategy fund offering.
